title: Joint preparation and installation.
officialText:
When required by Sections 1203.4 through 1203.14, the preparation and installation of
brazed, mechanical, soldered, solvent-cemented, threaded and welded joints shall comply with Sections 1203.3.1 through 1203.3.7.
